mapper.select: SELECT bd_mgt_sn AS buildingId, ST_Latitude(center) AS lat, ST_Longitude(center) AS lng, jibun_addr, road_addr, bld_nm, main_purps AS mainPurpsNm, grnd_flr, ugrnd_flr, use_apr_day FROM buildings WHERE MBRContains( ST_GeomFromText( CONCAT('POLYGON((', #{swLat}, ' ', #{swLng}, ',', #{swLat}, ' ', #{neLng}, ',', #{neLat}, ' ', #{neLng}, ',', #{neLat}, ' ', #{swLng}, ',', #{swLat}, ' ', #{swLng}, '))'), 4326), center) LIMIT #{limit}
